title: Terminal and Signal
author: Gideon Underhill
blurb: Jude Sandoval, a terraformer tending a garden meant for people not yet born, runs the long route between worlds that no longer speak. But when an unfamiliar name shows up on the manifest of a ship that never flew, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must decide which half of humanity wakes from cryosleep, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
